cause_quote: The team introduction wrote each member’s workspace as `workspace: path.join(workspaceRoot, member.id)`, while guided onboarding still recorded the parent directory as `workspace` in the setup receipt.
user_saw: Guided onboarding could pass the provider check without creating the requested team, or create all four agents and still fail to finish setup.
summary: The fix keeps first-run provider activation from claiming the agent roster and records the selected coordinator so setup can validate and recover the team under its approved workspace root.
reasoning: PR #145712 introduced the guided team option and placed the coordinator in a child directory, but receipt completion still required the coordinator’s workspace to equal the recorded parent directory. I checked that this mismatch existed in the introducing commit and that the intervening commits left the receipt check and team setup logic intact.
